entries.name: Lantern District
entries.entry: The Lantern District is the old merchant quarter. Every doorway carries a paper lantern; at dusk they are lit in order from the river inward.

entries.name: The Harbourmaster
entries.entry: The harbourmaster is a wide, patient woman named Osk. She has never once raised her voice and has never once been disobeyed.

entries.name: Tide Bell
entries.entry: A bronze bell on the sea wall. It rings twice a day; a third ring means the water is coming over the wall.
